# general

## Overview
General purpose JSON and string manipulation utilities (JsonUtilities, ObjectUtilities, StringUtilities).

## Interface
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.general.JsonUtilities
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.general.ObjectUtilities
- com.google.dart.server.utilities.general.StringUtilities

## Invariants
- Utility helper functions.

## Side Effects
- Pure string/JSON parsing and conversion.
